svg.title: 2. Checkout and order events (LLD)
svg.text: Every queue: visibility timeout > consumer timeout, maxReceiveCount 5,
then a DLQ. CloudWatch alarm on ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage.
Consumers keep a processed(order_id, event_id) table, so a retry is harmless.
Checkout on AWS: one transaction, then events
The synchronous path does as little as possible. Everything after "order accepted" happens from the outbox, on queues.

7 Consumers work at their own pace and
8 Poison messages land in a DLQ, with an
alarm on the age of the oldest message
